meta.title: Metamorphosis
meta.description: Nourished with love and given shelter, the sprout now awakens.

units.rawText: In the Middle Ring of Tartarus, at the old Sanctifier Watchtower [objectTower_b2].
units.displayText: In the Middle Ring of Tartarus, at the old Sanctifier Watchtower [objectTower_b2].

spans.text: In the Middle Ring of Tartarus, at the old Sanctifier Watchtower [objectTower_b2].

units.rawText: The purple tide of the Entropics is halted outside of the Halo, surrounding the entire area. However, the Entropics remain still. Perhaps they fear the damage that the Halo will do to them, or the petite figure standing guard in front of the Watchtower.
units.displayText: The purple tide of the Entropics is halted outside of the Halo, surrounding the entire area. However, the Entropics remain still. Perhaps they fear the damage that the Halo will do to them, or the petite figure standing guard in front of the Watchtower.

spans.text: The purple tide of the Entropics is halted outside of the Halo, surrounding the entire area. However, the Entropics remain still. Perhaps they fear the damage that the Halo will do to them, or the petite figure standing guard in front of the Watchtower.

units.rawText: Graahhh!
units.displayText: Graahhh!

spans.text: Graahhh!

units.rawText: With a twisted cry, the Entropics flood into the Halo from all directions. As they near its center, the horde weakens, deforms, and finally dissolves into Liquid Entropy.
units.displayText: With a twisted cry, the Entropics flood into the Halo from all directions. As they near its center, the horde weakens, deforms, and finally dissolves into Liquid Entropy.

spans.text: With a twisted cry, the Entropics flood into the Halo from all directions. As they near its center, the horde weakens, deforms, and finally dissolves into Liquid Entropy.

units.rawText: Judgement Arrow!
units.displayText: Judgement Arrow!

spans.text: Judgement Arrow!

units.rawText: The golden arrow parts the purple sea and dispatches countless Entropics.
units.displayText: The golden arrow parts the purple sea and dispatches countless Entropics.

spans.text: The golden arrow parts the purple sea and dispatches countless Entropics.

units.rawText: Targets struck. Now recharging...
units.displayText: Targets struck. Now recharging...

spans.text: Targets struck. Now recharging...

units.rawText: Golden operands gather in Alcyone's hands once again, but it seems as though the Entropic hordes around her have chosen this moment to speed up their advance on the Watchtower.
units.displayText: Golden operands gather in Alcyone's hands once again, but it seems as though the Entropic hordes around her have chosen this moment to speed up their advance on the Watchtower.

spans.text: Golden operands gather in Alcyone's hands once again, but it seems as though the Entropic hordes around her have chosen this moment to speed up their advance on the Watchtower.

units.rawText: Sentry guns, fire at will!
units.displayText: Sentry guns, fire at will!

spans.text: Sentry guns, fire at will!

units.rawText: Graaahhhhh!
units.displayText: Graaahhhhh!

spans.text: Graaahhhhh!

units.rawText: The Entropics are mercilessly slain by the fusillade of fire from the sentry guns, and Alcyone uses this brief respite to fully charge her operands.
units.displayText: The Entropics are mercilessly slain by the fusillade of fire from the sentry guns, and Alcyone uses this brief respite to fully charge her operands.

spans.text: The Entropics are mercilessly slain by the fusillade of fire from the sentry guns, and Alcyone uses this brief respite to fully charge her operands.

units.rawText: Her golden arrows and the interlocking fields of fire bring this battle to its conclusion.
units.displayText: Her golden arrows and the interlocking fields of fire bring this battle to its conclusion.

spans.text: Her golden arrows and the interlocking fields of fire bring this battle to its conclusion.

units.rawText: (Pants) Okay, I can do this...
units.displayText: (Pants) Okay, I can do this...

spans.text: (Pants) Okay, I can do this...

units.rawText: With the Halo and the Watchtower's defensive armament, I can hold out until the other two Watchtowers activate.
units.displayText: With the Halo and the Watchtower's defensive armament, I can hold out until the other two Watchtowers activate.

spans.text: With the Halo and the Watchtower's defensive armament, I can hold out until the other two Watchtowers activate.

units.rawText: During the battle, Alcyone looks back to where Electra is.
units.displayText: During the battle, Alcyone looks back to where Electra is.

spans.text: During the battle, Alcyone looks back to where Electra is.

units.rawText: Repair system operating. Repair progress at 40%.
units.displayText: Repair system operating. Repair progress at 40%.

spans.text: Repair system operating. Repair progress at 40%.

units.rawText: Only 40%? You need to hurry, Electra.
units.displayText: Only 40%? You need to hurry, Electra.

spans.text: Only 40%? You need to hurry, Electra.

units.rawText: Until then... I'll do my best, Atlas.
units.displayText: Until then... I'll do my best, Atlas.

spans.text: Until then... I'll do my best, Atlas.

units.rawText: Alcyone strokes the keepsake from Atlas and then looks resolutely outside the Halo again.
units.displayText: Alcyone strokes the keepsake from Atlas and then looks resolutely outside the Halo again.

spans.text: Alcyone strokes the keepsake from Atlas and then looks resolutely outside the Halo again.

units.rawText: Gah grah! Grah gah!
units.displayText: Gah grah! Grah gah!

spans.text: Gah grah! Grah gah!

units.rawText: Not going to give me a break, are you—
units.displayText: Not going to give me a break, are you—

spans.text: Not going to give me a break, are you—

units.rawText: Alcyone draws her longbow, but before she finishes charging up her shot, the Entropic army suddenly splits into three, each plunging into the Halo from a different direction.
units.displayText: Alcyone draws her longbow, but before she finishes charging up her shot, the Entropic army suddenly splits into three, each plunging into the Halo from a different direction.

spans.text: Alcyone draws her longbow, but before she finishes charging up her shot, the Entropic army suddenly splits into three, each plunging into the Halo from a different direction.

units.rawText: Alcyone does not hesitate. Instead, she calmly pulls her bowstring back. Her golden arrow scythes down the Entropic horde coming right at her. The sentry guns join the fray as well, targeting the other two groups.
units.displayText: Alcyone does not hesitate. Instead, she calmly pulls her bowstring back. Her golden arrow scythes down the Entropic horde coming right at her. The sentry guns join the fray as well, targeting the other two groups.

spans.text: Alcyone does not hesitate. Instead, she calmly pulls her bowstring back. Her golden arrow scythes down the Entropic horde coming right at her. The sentry guns join the fray as well, targeting the other two groups.

units.rawText: Under the severe damage inflicted by the gunfire and Halo, the foremost Entropic suddenly collapses. However, the Entropics that follow in its wake absorb its corpses even as they continue forward.
units.displayText: Under the severe damage inflicted by the gunfire and Halo, the foremost Entropic suddenly collapses. However, the Entropics that follow in its wake absorb its corpses even as they continue forward.

spans.text: Under the severe damage inflicted by the gunfire and Halo, the foremost Entropic suddenly collapses. However, the Entropics that follow in its wake absorb its corpses even as they continue forward.

units.rawText: Cannibalizing themselves, are they... These Daemons make me throw up.
units.displayText: Cannibalizing themselves, are they... These Daemons make me throw up.

spans.text: Cannibalizing themselves, are they... These Daemons make me throw up.

units.rawText: Still. Don't think of getting even a single step past me. Behind me stands—
units.displayText: Still. Don't think of getting even a single step past me. Behind me stands—

spans.text: Still. Don't think of getting even a single step past me. Behind me stands—

units.rawText: Rumble—
units.displayText: Rumble—

spans.text: Rumble—

units.rawText: Alcyone is about to draw her bow back when a violent shaking suddenly occurs from the Watchtower.
units.displayText: Alcyone is about to draw her bow back when a violent shaking suddenly occurs from the Watchtower.

spans.text: Alcyone is about to draw her bow back when a violent shaking suddenly occurs from the Watchtower.

units.rawText: This... This is?!
units.displayText: This... This is?!

spans.text: This... This is?!

units.rawText: The shaking is accompanied by ripples in the Halo projected by the tower, as though it might vanish at any moment.
units.displayText: The shaking is accompanied by ripples in the Halo projected by the tower, as though it might vanish at any moment.

spans.text: The shaking is accompanied by ripples in the Halo projected by the tower, as though it might vanish at any moment.

units.rawText: Warning! Core control is reporting that Halo is offline.
units.displayText: Warning! Core control is reporting that Halo is offline.

spans.text: Warning! Core control is reporting that Halo is offline.

units.rawText: Is it a malfunction? Did the Entropics infiltrate the Watchtower?
units.displayText: Is it a malfunction? Did the Entropics infiltrate the Watchtower?

spans.text: Is it a malfunction? Did the Entropics infiltrate the Watchtower?

units.rawText: Scanning for abnormal signals...
units.displayText: Scanning for abnormal signals...

spans.text: Scanning for abnormal signals...

units.rawText: Core region normal. Repair region normal. Fire control region normal... All regions scanned. No abnormal signals detected.
units.displayText: Core region normal. Repair region normal. Fire control region normal... All regions scanned. No abnormal signals detected.

spans.text: Core region normal. Repair region normal. Fire control region normal... All regions scanned. No abnormal signals detected.

units.rawText: The early warning systems are reporting everything is fine...
units.displayText: The early warning systems are reporting everything is fine...

spans.text: The early warning systems are reporting everything is fine...

units.rawText: Ahhhh, you useless thing! I'll go look myself!
units.displayText: Ahhhh, you useless thing! I'll go look myself!

spans.text: Ahhhh, you useless thing! I'll go look myself!

units.rawText: Crack—
units.displayText: Crack—

spans.text: Crack—

units.rawText: The wavering Halo shatters, and the writhing Entropics are suddenly revitalized. However, golden arrows drive them back before they can approach the Watchtower.
units.displayText: The wavering Halo shatters, and the writhing Entropics are suddenly revitalized. However, golden arrows drive them back before they can approach the Watchtower.

spans.text: The wavering Halo shatters, and the writhing Entropics are suddenly revitalized. However, golden arrows drive them back before they can approach the Watchtower.

units.rawText: Sentry guns, maximum firepower! Hold on until I get back!
units.displayText: Sentry guns, maximum firepower! Hold on until I get back!

spans.text: Sentry guns, maximum firepower! Hold on until I get back!

units.rawText: Alcyone fires off a few more explosive arrows to serve as land mines for the Entropics and then quickly flies back inside the tower.
units.displayText: Alcyone fires off a few more explosive arrows to serve as land mines for the Entropics and then quickly flies back inside the tower.

spans.text: Alcyone fires off a few more explosive arrows to serve as land mines for the Entropics and then quickly flies back inside the tower.

units.rawText: Inside the former Sanctifier Watchtower, at the core control terminal.
units.displayText: Inside the former Sanctifier Watchtower, at the core control terminal.

spans.text: Inside the former Sanctifier Watchtower, at the core control terminal.

units.rawText: (Coughs heavily)
units.displayText: Coughs heavily

spans.text: Coughs heavily

units.rawText: The terminal is surrounded by a cloud of smoke, joined by the occasional spark from short circuits.
units.displayText: The terminal is surrounded by a cloud of smoke, joined by the occasional spark from short circuits.

spans.text: The terminal is surrounded by a cloud of smoke, joined by the occasional spark from short circuits.

units.rawText: Dammit, when did the Entropics sneak in here?
units.displayText: Dammit, when did the Entropics sneak in here?

spans.text: Dammit, when did the Entropics sneak in here?

units.rawText: Alcyone draws her bow back all the way and fires a shot above the console.
units.displayText: Alcyone draws her bow back all the way and fires a shot above the console.

spans.text: Alcyone draws her bow back all the way and fires a shot above the console.

units.rawText: As the golden arrows streaks past, the wind of its passage sucks all the smoke away and leaves the room clear.
units.displayText: As the golden arrows streaks past, the wind of its passage sucks all the smoke away and leaves the room clear.

spans.text: As the golden arrows streaks past, the wind of its passage sucks all the smoke away and leaves the room clear.

units.rawText: ...Where are they?
units.displayText: ...Where are they?

spans.text: ...Where are they?

units.rawText: Her petite body tenses up and she scans the room over and over again, but there are still no Entropics in sight.
units.displayText: Her petite body tenses up and she scans the room over and over again, but there are still no Entropics in sight.

spans.text: Her petite body tenses up and she scans the room over and over again, but there are still no Entropics in sight.

units.rawText: Where are you hiding... Oh no!
units.displayText: Where are you hiding... Oh no!

spans.text: Where are you hiding... Oh no!

units.rawText: What if they've gone over to Electra?!
units.displayText: What if they've gone over to Electra?!

spans.text: What if they've gone over to Electra?!

units.rawText: Alcyone runs to the repair bay at top speed.
units.displayText: Alcyone runs to the repair bay at top speed.

spans.text: Alcyone runs to the repair bay at top speed.

units.rawText: But what awaits her there is the activated repair system.
units.displayText: But what awaits her there is the activated repair system.

spans.text: But what awaits her there is the activated repair system.

units.rawText: Electra... She's gone...
units.displayText: Electra... She's gone...

spans.text: Electra... She's gone...

units.rawText: Electra!! Where are you?!
units.displayText: Electra!! Where are you?!

spans.text: Electra!! Where are you?!

units.rawText: Her reflexes work faster than her conscious mind. Alcyone looks up excitedly, eager to face the owner of that voice.
units.displayText: Her reflexes work faster than her conscious mind. Alcyone looks up excitedly, eager to face the owner of that voice.

spans.text: Her reflexes work faster than her conscious mind. Alcyone looks up excitedly, eager to face the owner of that voice.

units.rawText: Stab—
units.displayText: Stab—

spans.text: Stab—

units.rawText: But instead, she is met by a sharp blade piercing into the mound of her abdomen.
units.displayText: But instead, she is met by a sharp blade piercing into the mound of her abdomen.

spans.text: But instead, she is met by a sharp blade piercing into the mound of her abdomen.

units.rawText: (Coughs and groans)
units.displayText: Coughs and groans

spans.text: Coughs and groans

units.rawText: Liquid Entropy pours deeply into the wound along the blade's length, and searing pain spreads inside her body. Alcyone looks at the monitor inside through her blurred vision, but it still displays the repair progress.
units.displayText: Liquid Entropy pours deeply into the wound along the blade's length, and searing pain spreads inside her body. Alcyone looks at the monitor inside through her blurred vision, but it still displays the repair progress.

spans.text: Liquid Entropy pours deeply into the wound along the blade's length, and searing pain spreads inside her body. Alcyone looks at the monitor inside through her blurred vision, but it still displays the repair progress.

units.rawText: Repair system operating. Repair progress at 40%.
units.displayText: Repair system operating. Repair progress at 40%.

spans.text: Repair system operating. Repair progress at 40%.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Mhm~ That's right, it's me, Ally.</color>
units.displayText: Mhm~ That's right, it's me, Ally.

spans.text: Mhm~ That's right, it's me, Ally.

units.rawText: I-Electra... Why...
units.displayText: I-Electra... Why...

spans.text: I-Electra... Why...

units.rawText: That familiar voice, that sudden attack, the ache in her belly, and the constant sound of the alarm...
units.displayText: That familiar voice, that sudden attack, the ache in her belly, and the constant sound of the alarm...

spans.text: That familiar voice, that sudden attack, the ache in her belly, and the constant sound of the alarm...

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Ah, you called my name, Big Sis Alcyone.</color>
units.displayText: Ah, you called my name, Big Sis Alcyone.

spans.text: Ah, you called my name, Big Sis Alcyone.

units.rawText: Warning, High Order Entropic signal detected.
units.displayText: Warning, High Order Entropic signal detected.

spans.text: Warning, High Order Entropic signal detected.

units.rawText: Electra... You... How did you...
units.displayText: Electra... You... How did you...

spans.text: Electra... You... How did you...

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Ah, but it isn't Big Sis Alcyone... but Ally.</color>
units.displayText: Ah, but it isn't Big Sis Alcyone... but Ally.

spans.text: Ah, but it isn't Big Sis Alcyone... but Ally.

units.rawText: The purple tracery, the strange body shape, and that crazed tone of voice. There is no doubt that this is Entropization.
units.displayText: The purple tracery, the strange body shape, and that crazed tone of voice. There is no doubt that this is Entropization.

spans.text: The purple tracery, the strange body shape, and that crazed tone of voice. There is no doubt that this is Entropization.

units.rawText: Entropization... Daemon... Guh...
units.displayText: Entropization... Daemon... Guh...

spans.text: Entropization... Daemon... Guh...

units.rawText: Dizziness gnaws at her neural cloud and Alcyone struggles to make out the look on Electra's face amidst the mass of alerts filling her vision.
units.displayText: Dizziness gnaws at her neural cloud and Alcyone struggles to make out the look on Electra's face amidst the mass of alerts filling her vision.

spans.text: Dizziness gnaws at her neural cloud and Alcyone struggles to make out the look on Electra's face amidst the mass of alerts filling her vision.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Ah, I'm sorry. Are you mad, Big Sis Alcyone? I was just playing a prank.</color>
units.displayText: Ah, I'm sorry. Are you mad, Big Sis Alcyone? I was just playing a prank.

spans.text: Ah, I'm sorry. Are you mad, Big Sis Alcyone? I was just playing a prank.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Does it hurt? Let me heal you.</color>
units.displayText: Does it hurt? Let me heal you.

spans.text: Does it hurt? Let me heal you.

units.rawText: Purple operands gather in Electra's hands. Electra steps forward, and Alcyone steps back.
units.displayText: Purple operands gather in Electra's hands. Electra steps forward, and Alcyone steps back.

spans.text: Purple operands gather in Electra's hands. Electra steps forward, and Alcyone steps back.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Don't move around, you'll open up the wound. Bear with it, Ally. Soon, you'll be a friend of mine, too.</color>
units.displayText: Don't move around, you'll open up the wound. Bear with it, Ally. Soon, you'll be a friend of mine, too.

spans.text: Don't move around, you'll open up the wound. Bear with it, Ally. Soon, you'll be a friend of mine, too.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>I'll be with Big Sis Alcyone forever...</color>
units.displayText: I'll be with Big Sis Alcyone forever...

spans.text: I'll be with Big Sis Alcyone forever...

units.rawText: Electra...
units.displayText: Electra...

spans.text: Electra...

units.rawText: Alcyone bites her lip and backs off to make room between the two of them. The blade removed from her wound as operands drips from it.
units.displayText: Alcyone bites her lip and backs off to make room between the two of them. The blade removed from her wound as operands drips from it.

spans.text: Alcyone bites her lip and backs off to make room between the two of them. The blade removed from her wound as operands drips from it.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Uwah, I told you not to move, that must have hurt, right...</color>
units.displayText: Uwah, I told you not to move, that must have hurt, right...

spans.text: Uwah, I told you not to move, that must have hurt, right...

units.rawText: <size=40>Stay back!</size>
units.displayText: Stay back!

spans.text: Stay back!

units.rawText: Alcyone manages to steady herself, and her hands tremble as she pulls back her bow and aims at the person before her.
units.displayText: Alcyone manages to steady herself, and her hands tremble as she pulls back her bow and aims at the person before her.

spans.text: Alcyone manages to steady herself, and her hands tremble as she pulls back her bow and aims at the person before her.

units.rawText: Electra... No... You're not Electra...
units.displayText: Electra... No... You're not Electra...

spans.text: Electra... No... You're not Electra...

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>But I AM Electra, Ally. I'm more awake now than I've ever been. I can sense everything from the past to the future.</color>
units.displayText: But I AM Electra, Ally. I'm more awake now than I've ever been. I can sense everything from the past to the future.

spans.text: But I AM Electra, Ally. I'm more awake now than I've ever been. I can sense everything from the past to the future.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Won't you join me? Along with <cmdr>, Eosphorus, and Eos... We'll all be together, and we'll never lose anything again.</color>
units.displayText: Won't you join me? Along with {교수}, Eosphorus, and Eos... We'll all be together, and we'll never lose anything again.

spans.text: Won't you join me? Along with
, Eosphorus, and Eos... We'll all be together, and we'll never lose anything again.

units.rawText: How did you become like this...
units.displayText: How did you become like this...

spans.text: How did you become like this...

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>How? Hm~ Why don't you take a guess, Ally?</color>
units.displayText: How? Hm~ Why don't you take a guess, Ally?

spans.text: How? Hm~ Why don't you take a guess, Ally?

units.rawText: As she looks at Electra's playful expression, a crimson figure suddenly appears in Alcyone's mind.
units.displayText: As she looks at Electra's playful expression, a crimson figure suddenly appears in Alcyone's mind.

spans.text: As she looks at Electra's playful expression, a crimson figure suddenly appears in Alcyone's mind.

units.rawText: Poof!
units.displayText: Poof!

spans.text: Poof!

units.rawText: What... GWAAAAARGH!
units.displayText: What... GWAAAAARGH!

spans.text: What... GWAAAAARGH!

units.rawText: An ominous purple spreads from the High Order Entropic's palm and explodes inside Electra's body.
units.displayText: An ominous purple spreads from the High Order Entropic's palm and explodes inside Electra's body.

spans.text: An ominous purple spreads from the High Order Entropic's palm and explodes inside Electra's body.

units.rawText: Warning, system structure damage at 50%. Warning, basic power transmission programs offline. Warning, system turbulence...
units.displayText: Warning, system structure damage at 50%. Warning, basic power transmission programs offline. Warning, system turbulence...

spans.text: Warning, system structure damage at 50%. Warning, basic power transmission programs offline. Warning, system turbulence...

units.rawText: Argh... (cough) D-damn you...
units.displayText: Argh... (cough) D-damn you...

spans.text: Argh... (cough) D-damn you...

units.rawText: It was Caina...
units.displayText: It was Caina...

spans.text: It was Caina...

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Well done, Ally. You figured it out so soon. That's right, it was thanks to Caina's hard work~</color>
units.displayText: Well done, Ally. You figured it out so soon. That's right, it was thanks to Caina's hard work~

spans.text: Well done, Ally. You figured it out so soon. That's right, it was thanks to Caina's hard work~

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Although, the reason why this Seed of Entropization could flourish was due to YOUR efforts, Ally.</color>
units.displayText: Although, the reason why this Seed of Entropization could flourish was due to YOUR efforts, Ally.

spans.text: Although, the reason why this Seed of Entropization could flourish was due to YOUR efforts, Ally.

units.rawText: Huh? You... What do you mean?
units.displayText: Huh? You... What do you mean?

spans.text: Huh? You... What do you mean?

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>It's because you were so kind and cautious as to perform a deep repair on me, Ally. That gave the Seed of Entropization the perfect time in which to gestate.</color>
units.displayText: It's because you were so kind and cautious as to perform a deep repair on me, Ally. That gave the Seed of Entropization the perfect time in which to gestate.

spans.text: It's because you were so kind and cautious as to perform a deep repair on me, Ally. That gave the Seed of Entropization the perfect time in which to gestate.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>And the operands from the repair process gave the Seed all the nutrients it needed~ See how lovely it is.</color>
units.displayText: And the operands from the repair process gave the Seed all the nutrients it needed~ See how lovely it is.

spans.text: And the operands from the repair process gave the Seed all the nutrients it needed~ See how lovely it is.

units.rawText: Electra runs her claws lightly over her body. She seems very satisfied with her current state.
units.displayText: Electra runs her claws lightly over her body. She seems very satisfied with her current state.

spans.text: Electra runs her claws lightly over her body. She seems very satisfied with her current state.

units.rawText: As she watches the irrational Electra, Alcyone wants to say something, but the words refuse to leave her throat.
units.displayText: As she watches the irrational Electra, Alcyone wants to say something, but the words refuse to leave her throat.

spans.text: As she watches the irrational Electra, Alcyone wants to say something, but the words refuse to leave her throat.

units.rawText: <color=red>I should have performed a full diagnostic on Electra back then when she skipped it I should have insisted on it if only I had don't leave me Electra it's all my fault I'm sorry Atlas <cmdr> Lord Eosphorus</color>
units.displayText: I should have performed a full diagnostic on Electra back then when she skipped it I should have insisted on it if only I had don't leave me Electra it's all my fault I'm sorry Atlas {교수} Lord Eosphorus

spans.text: I should have performed a full diagnostic on Electra back then when she skipped it I should have insisted on it if only I had don't leave me Electra it's all my fault I'm sorry Atlas
Lord Eosphorus

units.rawText: Ah...
units.displayText: Ah...

spans.text: Ah...

units.rawText: Alcyone touches her chest in pain, but her eyes are fixed on the Watchtower's core control terminal.
units.displayText: Alcyone touches her chest in pain, but her eyes are fixed on the Watchtower's core control terminal.

spans.text: Alcyone touches her chest in pain, but her eyes are fixed on the Watchtower's core control terminal.

units.rawText: (Now isn't the time for self-pity!)
units.displayText: Now isn't the time for self-pity!

spans.text: Now isn't the time for self-pity!

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Wow... I'm surprised. You're still thinking about how to complete your mission, even now.</color>
units.displayText: Wow... I'm surprised. You're still thinking about how to complete your mission, even now.

spans.text: Wow... I'm surprised. You're still thinking about how to complete your mission, even now.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Earnest and reliable little Ally. Ah, you're just like Big Sis Alcyone was in the past~</color>
units.displayText: Earnest and reliable little Ally. Ah, you're just like Big Sis Alcyone was in the past~

spans.text: Earnest and reliable little Ally. Ah, you're just like Big Sis Alcyone was in the past~

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Even when she encountered difficulties, she'd pull herself together. She was small, but she always stood in front of me to protect me.</color>

Alcyone answers with her actions.

units.rawText: Don't look down on me.
units.displayText: Don't look down on me.

spans.text: Don't look down on me.

units.rawText: And don't look down on Electra!
units.displayText: And don't look down on Electra!

spans.text: And don't look down on Electra!

units.rawText: Why won't you let me go to the border battlefront? My training scores have exceeded the passing mark many times!
units.displayText: Why won't you let me go to the border battlefront? My training scores have exceeded the passing mark many times!

spans.text: Why won't you let me go to the border battlefront? My training scores have exceeded the passing mark many times!

units.rawText: Ally, it isn't time yet.
units.displayText: Ally, it isn't time yet.

spans.text: Ally, it isn't time yet.

units.rawText: I want to go wipe out the Entropics with you and <cmdr>...

units.rawText: Aw, it's enough that you're thinking like that, Ally...
units.displayText: Aw, it's enough that you're thinking like that, Ally...

spans.text: Aw, it's enough that you're thinking like that, Ally...

units.rawText: Stop treating me like a kid! Didn't we use to go on missions together before I was reset? Why can't I do it now? I...

spans.text: Stop treating me like a kid! Didn't we use to go on missions together before I was reset? Why can't I do it now? I...

units.displayText: Squishsquish...

units.rawText: Uwah! Who's that?!
units.displayText: Uwah! Who's that?!

spans.text: Uwah! Who's that?!

units.rawText: Ah, your cheeks are so soft and puffy, they feel so good~
units.displayText: Ah, your cheeks are so soft and puffy, they feel so good~

spans.text: Ah, your cheeks are so soft and puffy, they feel so good~

units.rawText: ELECTRA!!
units.displayText: ELECTRA!!

spans.text: ELECTRA!!

units.rawText: Hahaha, Electra, are you back from the frontlines?
units.displayText: Hahaha, Electra, are you back from the frontlines?

spans.text: Hahaha, Electra, are you back from the frontlines?

units.rawText: Yes, I am. What's happening, is Ally being difficult?
units.displayText: Yes, I am. What's happening, is Ally being difficult?

spans.text: Yes, I am. What's happening, is Ally being difficult?

units.rawText: I am NOT being difficult! I...
units.displayText: I am NOT being difficult! I...

spans.text: I am NOT being difficult! I...

units.rawText: I just don't want you to treat me like a kid, I want to be like everyone...
units.displayText: I just don't want you to treat me like a kid, I want to be like everyone...

spans.text: I just don't want you to treat me like a kid, I want to be like everyone...

units.rawText: Ally, the border battlefront is different from your training, you know.
units.displayText: Ally, the border battlefront is different from your training, you know.

spans.text: Ally, the border battlefront is different from your training, you know.

units.rawText: Electra's smile fades and she gives Alcyone a serious look, but Alcyone gets the feeling that she's looking through her and at someone else.
units.displayText: Electra's smile fades and she gives Alcyone a serious look, but Alcyone gets the feeling that she's looking through her and at someone else.

spans.text: Electra's smile fades and she gives Alcyone a serious look, but Alcyone gets the feeling that she's looking through her and at someone else.

units.rawText: The Entropics' action far surpass what our systems can predict; a single mistake might lead to you and your friends being lost.
units.displayText: The Entropics' action far surpass what our systems can predict; a single mistake might lead to you and your friends being lost.

spans.text: The Entropics' action far surpass what our systems can predict; a single mistake might lead to you and your friends being lost.

units.rawText: Sanctifiers are reset every battle, or even outright deleted... Entropized agents cannot be reset, and the same applies for Sanctifiers, too.
units.displayText: Sanctifiers are reset every battle, or even outright deleted... Entropized agents cannot be reset, and the same applies for Sanctifiers, too.

spans.text: Sanctifiers are reset every battle, or even outright deleted... Entropized agents cannot be reset, and the same applies for Sanctifiers, too.

units.rawText: If you're not prepared, you'll have to end up living with regret and resentment in your heart...
units.displayText: If you're not prepared, you'll have to end up living with regret and resentment in your heart...

spans.text: If you're not prepared, you'll have to end up living with regret and resentment in your heart...

units.rawText: Electra, that's enough...
units.displayText: Electra, that's enough...

spans.text: Electra, that's enough...

units.rawText: I... My fighting power is perfectly fine! I won't mess up!
units.displayText: I... My fighting power is perfectly fine! I won't mess up!

spans.text: I... My fighting power is perfectly fine! I won't mess up!

units.rawText: Sometimes, there are situations you can't easily escape, even if you don't make mistakes. When I say "you're not prepared", I'm not just referring to your ability to fight.
units.displayText: Sometimes, there are situations you can't easily escape, even if you don't make mistakes. When I say "you're not prepared", I'm not just referring to your ability to fight.

spans.text: Sometimes, there are situations you can't easily escape, even if you don't make mistakes. When I say "you're not prepared", I'm not just referring to your ability to fight.

units.rawText: Electra picks up one of Alcyone's arrows and hands it to her.
units.displayText: Electra picks up one of Alcyone's arrows and hands it to her.

spans.text: Electra picks up one of Alcyone's arrows and hands it to her.

units.rawText: Defending Magrasea and fighting the Entropics is both our calling as Sanctifiers, and our glory.
units.displayText: Defending Magrasea and fighting the Entropics is both our calling as Sanctifiers, and our glory.

spans.text: Defending Magrasea and fighting the Entropics is both our calling as Sanctifiers, and our glory.

units.rawText: If I were infected by the Entropy and you had to delete me to keep it from spreading, could you do it?
units.displayText: If I were infected by the Entropy and you had to delete me to keep it from spreading, could you do it?

spans.text: If I were infected by the Entropy and you had to delete me to keep it from spreading, could you do it?

units.rawText: If I were Entropized and you had to fight me to the death, could you shoot this arrow at me?
units.displayText: If I were Entropized and you had to fight me to the death, could you shoot this arrow at me?

spans.text: If I were Entropized and you had to fight me to the death, could you shoot this arrow at me?

units.rawText: Who... Who says I can't!?!
units.displayText: Who... Who says I can't!?!

spans.text: Who... Who says I can't!?!

units.displayText: Alcyone snatches the arrow from Electra and squeezes it tightly.

spans.text: Alcyone snatches the arrow from Electra and squeezes it tightly.

units.rawText: If that day really comes...
units.displayText: If that day really comes...

spans.text: If that day really comes...

units.rawText: You're shaking, Ally.
units.displayText: You're shaking, Ally.

spans.text: You're shaking, Ally.

units.rawText: You're not ready yet.
units.displayText: You're not ready yet.

spans.text: You're not ready yet.

units.displayText: Your arrow isn't ready to kill.

spans.text: Your arrow isn't ready to kill.

units.rawText: Alright, alright, we're not training now, so better put that arrow away.
units.displayText: Alright, alright, we're not training now, so better put that arrow away.

spans.text: Alright, alright, we're not training now, so better put that arrow away.

units.displayText: Atlas waves his hand to break up the deadlock between them.

spans.text: Atlas waves his hand to break up the deadlock between them.

units.rawText: You've been at the border battlefront all this time and only just came back. You should get some rest, Electra.

spans.text: You've been at the border battlefront all this time and only just came back. You should get some rest, Electra.

units.displayText: ...Hehehe, I guess I AM feeling a little tired.

spans.text: ...Hehehe, I guess I AM feeling a little tired.

units.displayText: Electra looks down at her clothes, which are spattered with operands and Liquid Entropy. Her smile is back on her face when she looks up again.

spans.text: Electra looks down at her clothes, which are spattered with operands and Liquid Entropy. Her smile is back on her face when she looks up again.

units.rawText: Sorry for being so stern just now, Ally. Ahhhh, I'm not supposed to have a personality like that—
units.displayText: Sorry for being so stern just now, Ally. Ahhhh, I'm not supposed to have a personality like that—

spans.text: Sorry for being so stern just now, Ally. Ahhhh, I'm not supposed to have a personality like that—

units.displayText: To apologize, why don't I take you with me next time when I slack off?

spans.text: To apologize, why don't I take you with me next time when I slack off?

units.rawText: I'm not going to slack off!
units.displayText: I'm not going to slack off!

spans.text: I'm not going to slack off!

spans.text: Once Ally is ready...

units.displayText: Look at me, Electra.

spans.text: Look at me, Electra.

units.displayText: This time, I won't let you bear that regret again.

units.displayText: But I won't be careless again this time!

units.rawText: <color=orange>...</color>
<color=orange>Of course I knew that the "Alcyone" from before the reset was your big sister. I learned that instantly from a casual search of the database.</color>
units.displayText: Of course I knew that the "Alcyone" from before the reset was your big sister. I learned that instantly from a casual search of the database.

spans.text: Of course I knew that the "Alcyone" from before the reset was your big sister. I learned that instantly from a casual search of the database.

units.rawText: <color=orange>But she wasn't me.</color>
units.displayText: But she wasn't me.

spans.text: But she wasn't me.

units.rawText: <color=orange>The "Alcyone" in your heart must have been someone you cherished more than anyone else.</color>
units.displayText: The "Alcyone" in your heart must have been someone you cherished more than anyone else.

spans.text: The "Alcyone" in your heart must have been someone you cherished more than anyone else.

units.rawText: <color=orange>But I don't remember anything about her.</color>
units.displayText: But I don't remember anything about her.

spans.text: But I don't remember anything about her.

units.rawText: <color=orange>If you wanted to use me as a substitute for her, I could have cooperated with you and become her.</color>
units.displayText: If you wanted to use me as a substitute for her, I could have cooperated with you and become her.

spans.text: If you wanted to use me as a substitute for her, I could have cooperated with you and become her.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Or, if you didn't want to see me, I could have simply stayed away from you.</color>
units.displayText: Or, if you didn't want to see me, I could have simply stayed away from you.

spans.text: Or, if you didn't want to see me, I could have simply stayed away from you.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Whatever you wanted, I could accommodate and make it work—</color>
units.displayText: Whatever you wanted, I could accommodate and make it work—

spans.text: Whatever you wanted, I could accommodate and make it work—

units.rawText: <color=orange>At least, that's what I thought would happen, but then you skipped up to me and called me your little sister.</color>
units.displayText: At least, that's what I thought would happen, but then you skipped up to me and called me your little sister.

spans.text: At least, that's what I thought would happen, but then you skipped up to me and called me your little sister.

units.rawText: <color=orange>You even forced me to eat chocolates.</color>
units.displayText: You even forced me to eat chocolates.

spans.text: You even forced me to eat chocolates.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Eating is pointless for a Sanctifier, and that stuff was bitter and sweet...</color>
units.displayText: Eating is pointless for a Sanctifier, and that stuff was bitter and sweet...

spans.text: Eating is pointless for a Sanctifier, and that stuff was bitter and sweet...

units.rawText: <color=orange>You never once mentioned the "Alcyone" from before to me.</color>
units.displayText: You never once mentioned the "Alcyone" from before to me.

spans.text: You never once mentioned the "Alcyone" from before to me.

units.rawText: <color=orange>That was a relief. Having a big sister felt pretty good, too.</color>
units.displayText: That was a relief. Having a big sister felt pretty good, too.

spans.text: That was a relief. Having a big sister felt pretty good, too.

units.rawText: <color=orange>And... the chocolate... It tasted good, too...</color>
units.displayText: And... the chocolate... It tasted good, too...

spans.text: And... the chocolate... It tasted good, too...

units.displayText: Remaining operands... 13%.

units.displayText: No need to shout, I'm here~
